decisions.reason: The IMU module fits the modular building-block system closely, and the firm's own hardware, firmware and API expertise lets it read early results and refine the module at low cost, although the platform's move to newer connectors may eventually prompt a successor version.
The AC voltage input module builds on established measurement and power know-how, has its own product page, and supports the strategic push into industrial and energy-management applications.

The server room kit bundles sensors and software the firm understands well, so it is cheap to maintain, but as a niche kit it faces more market uncertainty and is a likely candidate for consolidation.
The RGB LED control module is a newly launched building block that draws directly on existing controller and firmware competence, so it deserves time for the firm to learn from early results.

The wallbox remote access service extends the growing charging and energy-management line where the firm is investing, and its software know-how lets it absorb customer feedback and improve the service.
